findings.evidence: `Theorem.lean:71-72` uses `contractable_of_exchangeable hX.1 ...`; `code/TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/ConditionallyIIDImplications.lean:102` defines `theorem ConditionallyIID.contractable ... : Contractable μ X`.
findings.fix: Replace the reverse branch with `fun hX => hX.2.contractable` (or `ConditionallyIID.contractable hX.2`) and update the docstring to cite `ConditionallyIID.contractable` for that direction.
findings.issue: The reverse direction of `contractable_iff_exchangeable_and_conditionallyIID` proves `Contractable μ X` from the redundant `Exchangeable` conjunct via `contractable_of_exchangeable`, even though the `ConditionallyIID` conjunct already has the exact existing implication.

summary: The new equivalence API is not directly present elsewhere, but one proof re-derives an existing conditionally-i.i.d. implication instead of using the stronger local lemma.
